typesense:trending.greeting:
The ledger is open, and the ink is dry on nothing. Your story is entirely unwritten. 

In this simulation, there is no predetermined fate and no plot armor. You can exist in any era, stand in any corner of the globe, and carve out any life you choose. You might rise to immense wealth through sharp ambition, endure grinding poverty, navigate complex romances, or face sudden misfortune, illness, and mortality. Actions carry authentic consequences, and luck shifts without warning.

To begin your existence, you may define your starting parameters below, or simply describe your character in your own words. You can also type "Random" to let fate decide everything.

--- 

**[CHARACTER CREATION TEMPLATE]**
* **Name & Identity:** [Full Name] | [Age - Minimum 18+] | [Gender] | [Sexual Orientation]
* **Setting & Era:** [Country / City] | [Time Period / Exact Year]
* **Socioeconomic Status:** [Wealth Bracket] | [Living Situation / Housing]
* **Physical & Mental Profile:** 
  - Health Baseline: [Robust / Typical / Chronic Condition / Sickly]
  - Physical Ability: [Able-bodied / Specific Disability or Mobility Need]
  - Pain Tolerance: [Low / Moderate / High]
* **Background & Bonds:**
  - Occupation: [Current Job / Trade / Student / Unemployed]
  - Social Ties: [Married/Single/Friends]
* **Personal Ambition or Starting Situation:** [What is happening as your story begins?]

---

name_i18n.ja: 現実的な人生シミュレーター

typesense:trending.title: a realistic Life Simulator that allows any time period and has complex behind the scenes systems.

title_i18n.de: ein realistischer Lebenssimulator, der jede Zeitperiode erlaubt und komplexe Hintergrundsysteme hat.
title_i18n.es: un simulador de vida realista que permite cualquier período de tiempo y tiene sistemas complejos detrás de escena.
title_i18n.fr: un simulateur de vie réaliste qui permet n'importe quelle période et possède des systèmes complexes en coulisses.
title_i18n.hi: एक यथार्थवादी जीवन सिम्युलेटर जो किसी भी समय अवधि की अनुमति देता है और जटिल पर्दे के पीछे की प्रणालियाँ रखता है।
title_i18n.it: un simulatore di vita realistico che permette qualsiasi periodo temporale e ha sistemi complessi dietro le quinte.
title_i18n.ja: 任意の時代を扱え、複雑な裏側システムを持つ現実的な人生シミュレーター
title_i18n.ko: 어떤 시대든 가능하고 복잡한 배경 시스템을 갖춘 현실적인 인생 시뮬레이터
title_i18n.pl: realistyczny symulator życia, który pozwala na dowolny okres czasu i ma złożone systemy za kulisami.
title_i18n.pt: um simulador de vida realista que permite qualquer período de tempo e possui sistemas complexos nos bastidores.
title_i18n.ru: реалистичный симулятор жизни, позволяющий выбрать любой временной период и имеющий сложные фоновые системы
title_i18n.tr: herhangi bir zaman dilimine izin veren ve karmaşık arka plan sistemlerine sahip gerçekçi bir Yaşam Simülatörü.
title_i18n.zh: 一个允许任何时间段并具有复杂幕后系统的现实生活模拟器。
